name: 海优新材
current_thesis: HIUV is in a post-downcycle repair phase for photovoltaic encapsulant film, with automotive PDCLC/PVE materials as the main upside option. As of 2026Q1 the company was still loss-making and gross margin had only turned slightly positive, while the current share price already prices in part of the recovery and automotive ramp-up. Wait for either a lower price with margin of safety or clear earnings delivery.

position_plan.condition: Only consider a starter position if the share price enters 22-26 CNY and 2026H1 gross margin remains positive without a sharp operating cash flow deterioration.
Add only after two consecutive quarters with gross margin above 5%, non-GAAP quarterly loss narrowed to below 10 million CNY or turned positive, and measurable automotive materials revenue growth.
Avoid or reduce attention if the share price exceeds 45 CNY while automotive ramp-up is not disclosed and the company remains loss-making.

price_triggers.reason: Price enters the upper end of the watch-to-buy zone; recheck H1 margin, cash flow and automotive revenue.
Price approaches the estimated margin-of-safety zone and may justify reassessing a small position.
Price enters the optimistic scenario range; without fundamental delivery, risk-reward deteriorates.

review_triggers.reason: Review 2026 interim report for revenue, gross margin, adjusted profit, cash flow, receivables and automotive materials ramp-up.
Review 2026 third-quarter report to confirm whether photovoltaic film pricing recovery and automotive business momentum continue.
Review 2026 annual report to judge whether the company has shifted from loss repair to sustainable profitability.
